summary: Practise SQL extraction, Python batch transformations and PostgreSQL loads. Build ETL checks and run records. Explore the course outline.
lede: ETL training helps aspiring data engineers, database support staff and analysts move data from source files and databases into checked reporting stores. You learn to profile sources, map fields, write SQL transformations and build basic batch loads using PostgreSQL and starter Python scripts, then validate data quality and reconcile source-to-target counts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, move, validate or troubleshoot data between operational sources and reporting stores. It suits beginners with basic SQL familiarity who need practical ETL skills for routine data workflows.
modules: ETL Flow Boundaries and Data Paths
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with Python and PostgreSQL installed. Basic SQL and familiarity with tabular data or CSV files are expected; previous ETL experience is not required. Exercises use starter Python scripts and sample CSV files, so you will make small code edits rather than build software from scratch.
